title: Original Grinds
venue_description:
Original Grinds

Tucked into a storefront on Caroline Street in the heart of downtown Fredericksburg, Original Grinds bills itself as an indie coffeeshop, vegan bakery and creative safe space rolled into one. It is also, by design, a sober venue — there is no bar here, just coffee, baked goods and a small stage that has become one of the most welcoming rooms in town for first-time performers.

Atmosphere and Setting

The shop leans warm and lived-in rather than polished: mismatched seating, local art on the walls, and a counter turning out vegan pastries alongside espresso drinks. Because there is no alcohol involved, the crowd skews younger and more all-ages than a typical bar open mic, and the room has a distinctly community-center feel — regulars greet each other by name, and newcomers are pulled into conversation quickly.

Open Mic Wednesdays

The shop's signature recurring event is Open Mic Wednesdays, held every Wednesday night. Sign-ups start at 7:00 PM at the counter, with the show beginning around 7:30 PM. Sets are kept to roughly 10 minutes to give everyone a turn, though the night has a habit of running past 10:00 PM when the room is full of energy. The genre mix is genuinely wide open — acoustic singer-songwriters, hip hop artists, spoken word poets and everything adjacent are all part of a typical lineup. There is no cover charge, though buying a coffee or a baked good is the customary way to support the free weekly show.

Other Programming

Original Grinds also runs Breaking Lines, a recurring poetry and spoken-word night billed as “a night of spoken word, expression, and art,” and it regularly rotates in work from local painters and visual artists on its walls. The shop has become something of a hub for Fredericksburg's younger and DIY-minded creative community, filling a niche that the town's bar-based music venues don't really reach.

For Performers

Because it is a sober, all-ages space, Original Grinds is an especially good starting point for performers who are nervous about their first open mic, or for younger musicians and writers who can't get into a 21-and-up bar show. No formal audition or registration in advance is needed — just show up by 7:00 PM and add your name to the list.

Good to Know

Original Grinds is located at 615 Caroline Street, Fredericksburg, VA 22401, within easy walking distance of the Rappahannock riverfront and the rest of downtown's shops and restaurants. Free parking is available near the shop. Reach out on Instagram at @ogsfxbg or by email for the most current schedule.

title: Curitiba Art Cafe
venue_description:
Curitiba Art Cafe

Curitiba Art Cafe brings a slice of Brazil to Caroline Street, serving specialty Brazilian coffee and espresso alongside pastries, light fare, craft cocktails, beer and wine. Beyond the menu, the cafe describes itself as a hub for local artists across disciplines, and its indoor and patio seating regularly doubles as a stage, gallery and gathering space for Fredericksburg's creative community.

Atmosphere and Setting

The cafe's owners describe their approach as “people first,” and it shows in the room: warm lighting, artwork from local painters on the walls, and a layout flexible enough to host everything from quiet daytime coffee meetings to a packed evening of live jazz. The vibe sits somewhere between coffeehouse and listening room, with both an indoor stage area and outdoor patio seating.

Fredericksburg Jazz Collective Jazz Jam

Since late 2024, Curitiba has been the permanent home of the Fredericksburg Jazz Collective's monthly all-ages jazz jam, held on the second Thursday of each month from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. The collective spent a decade at Colonial Tavern before relocating when that venue became unavailable for a Jazz4Justice after-concert jam; the group found Curitiba's “cool eclectic environment” such a good fit that they made the move permanent.

Each session opens with a roughly 40-minute set from a rotating host band — past hosts have included groups like the John Vreeland Quintet — after which guitarist Bruce Middle helps pair up musicians and singers who want to sit in. Groups are encouraged to register together and play two or three songs, though solo musicians are welcome to join as well. The jam draws a genuinely wide range of players, from 12-year-old students to University of Mary Washington faculty, and donations collected at the door support the nonprofit collective's work introducing local students to jazz.

Other Programming

Beyond the monthly jazz jam, Curitiba's calendar includes live acoustic performances, comedy nights, drag shows and community art events, and the space is also used by local writing and photography groups for regular meetups.

Good to Know

Curitiba Art Cafe is located at 919 Caroline Street, Fredericksburg, VA 22401, in the heart of downtown's Caroline Street corridor. Because the jazz jam runs monthly rather than weekly, it's worth checking the Fredericksburg Jazz Collective's calendar (fredjazz.org) to confirm the date before visiting.

title: Adventure Brewing North
venue_description:
Adventure Brewing North

Adventure Brewing North is a large, family- and dog-friendly craft brewery on the north side of Fredericksburg, built around a rotating lineup of house-brewed beers and a genuinely active events calendar. Along with pours flowing from the taproom, the brewery has built a reputation as one of the more reliable spots in the area for live music, trivia and community events.

Atmosphere and Setting

The taproom is spacious and casual, with the industrial feel typical of a working brewery, plenty of seating, and room for a small stage setup. It draws a broad, all-ages crowd during the day and a livelier bar scene in the evenings, especially on the weekends when live bands are booked.

Open Mic Night

Every other week, Adventure Brewing North hosts an Open Mic Night from about 7:00 PM to 9:30 PM, open to musicians, comedians and poets at every experience level. Sign-ups begin at 6:30 PM, and performers are typically given 10 to 15 minutes on stage. The brewery supplies real backline for the night — two 250-watt PA speakers with a monitor, two to three vocal and instrument microphones, and a 16-channel soundboard that accepts XLR, 1/4-inch and AUX inputs — plus a house acoustic guitar for anyone who wants to play but didn't bring an instrument.

Other Programming

Adventure Brewing North books live bands most Friday and Saturday nights, in addition to running trivia nights and other community programming throughout the week. Local and touring musicians interested in a booked set, rather than an open-mic slot, can reach the brewery's booking team directly or fill out the Band Booking Inquiry Form on its website.

Good to Know

Adventure Brewing North is located at 33 Perchwood Drive, Unit 101, Fredericksburg, VA 22405. Because the open mic runs on a biweekly rather than weekly schedule, check the brewery's online event calendar to confirm the next date before heading over.

title: Colonial Beach Brewing
venue_description:
Colonial Beach Brewing

Colonial Beach Brewing is a small-batch brewery operating out of a converted service station garage in historic downtown Colonial Beach, a small Potomac River town on Virginia's Northern Neck, roughly a 30-minute drive from Fredericksburg. Since opening in 2016 and expanding into adjacent space the following year, it has become a local gathering spot known as much for its laid-back, hometown character as for its beer.

Atmosphere and Setting

The brewery keeps its garage roots visible, with a casual, unpretentious taproom that leans into its small-town setting rather than away from it. It is the kind of place where regulars are on a first-name basis with the staff, and where an evening might include anything from a quiet pint to a full house for live music.

Open Mic Night

Most Thursday evenings starting around 6:00 PM, local musician Brian Jarboe hosts an open mic that draws pickers, singers and regulars from around Colonial Beach and the surrounding Northern Neck communities. It runs as a casual, drop-in session rather than a tightly scheduled show, so the exact end time varies with how many performers turn out.

Other Programming

Beyond the Thursday open mic, Colonial Beach Brewing books touring and local bands for select Friday and Saturday night shows throughout the year, making it one of the more consistent live-music stops on the Northern Neck.

Good to Know

Colonial Beach Brewing is located at 215C Washington Avenue, Colonial Beach, VA 22443. Because the open mic runs on a most-Thursdays rather than guaranteed-weekly basis, it's worth a quick call or a check of the brewery's Facebook page before making the drive from Fredericksburg.
